arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'flight' AS kind, flight_id AS id, json_object('capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) AS data FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache', key, value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold', hold_id, json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'incomplete_booking', b.booking_id, json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' OR c.booking_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
